summaries.Romania: Romania faces mounting fiscal pressures with debt rising to 79.4B lei and budget deficits threatening credit ratings, while administrative reforms and security investments proceed. President Nicușor Dan navigates diplomatic tensions abroad while managing domestic controversies over press freedom and institutional accountability.
summaries.Healthcare: The American Cancer Society reversed decade-old prostate cancer screening guidelines to recommend routine PSA testing, while healthcare systems grapple with AI implementation costs and Medicare's prior authorization reforms take shape. Innovation continues in obesity treatments, biotech acquisitions, and digital health platforms despite workforce pressures.
summaries.Tech: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO following affairs and espionage concerns sent shockwaves through AI infrastructure, with Colette Kress taking interim control and Microsoft Outlook suffering a major outage. Apple launched HomeView smart displays and new Apple TV with Siri AI, while Google debuted Gemini 4 Hydrogen and new smart eyewear with iOS support.

items.title: Is AI Really Saving Hospitals Money? A New Study Raises Questions About the Cost of AI-Driven Care
items.snippet:
Healthcare systems are investing in AI to streamline workflows and save money, but a new study in the New England Journal of Medicine shows that AI-generated care plans might actually cost far more than those ordered by physicians.
. 
The post Is AI Really Saving Hospitals Money? A New Study Raises
items.line: Study questions whether AI-generated clinical care plans actually cost more than physician-ordered care, challenging cost-saving assumptions driving healthcare AI adoption.
